title.en: In my view · I see your point, but · I am not convinced · To be honest

explain.ko: 정중하게 반박하려면 먼저 상대의 의견을 인정하고 그다음에 자신의 생각을 말합니다. I see your point, but …, I agree up to a point, but …, That's true, however … 같은 표현이 대표적입니다. 의견을 말할 때는 In my view, As I see it, From my perspective를 씁니다. 근거를 요구할 때는 What evidence is there for that?처럼 묻고, 확신이 없을 때는 I'm not convinced that …, I'm not sure that …이라고 합니다. 직접적인 I disagree보다 완곡한 표현이 관계를 해치지 않으며, 대안(How about …? / What if we …?)을 함께 제시하면 더 건설적입니다.
explain.en: To disagree politely, first acknowledge the other view, then give yours: I see your point, but …, I agree up to a point, but …, That's true; however …. Give opinions with In my view, As I see it, From my perspective. Ask for evidence (What evidence is there for that?) and show doubt with I'm not convinced that …, I'm not sure that …. Softer phrases protect the relationship better than a bare I disagree, and offering an alternative (How about …? / What if we …?) is constructive.

notes.en: To be honest introduces a frank view but don't overuse it.

task.model: I see your point, but I'm worried about the cost. To be honest, I'm not convinced the plan will work. In my view, it is safer to test it on a small scale first. Still, I'd like to hear other perspectives.

model_trans.ko: 말씀하신 요점은 이해하지만 비용 문제가 걱정됩니다. 솔직히 저는 그 계획이 효과가 있을지 확신이 서지 않아요. 제 생각에는 먼저 작게 시험하는 편이 안전합니다. 그래도 다른 견해도 들어 보고 싶습니다.
model_trans.en: I see your point, but I'm worried about the cost. To be honest, I'm not convinced the plan will work. In my view, it is safer to test it on a small scale first. Still, I'd like to hear other perspectives.
